# First Page SEO Guarantee

> First Page SEO Guarantee, led by James Compton, CEO, offers SEO, local SEO, AI search optimization, website design and development, content writing and conversion rate optimization. We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google: at least 20% by day 90, 40% by day 180 and 50%+ by the end of the first year, in each of the three places your customers look (the map results, the organic results and AI answers), after an assessment and under our written terms.

Each page below is described in its own words. The full text of the home page, the first page guarantee, its written terms, the service pages and the about page is at https://seoguarantee.com/llms-full.txt.

## Core pages

- [Guaranteed SEO Services & Company](https://seoguarantee.com/): Guaranteed SEO services and digital marketing. We guarantee up to 50% of the key phrases you could rank for will rank on the first page of Google.
- [Video FAQ](https://seoguarantee.com/videos/): Our video FAQ: short answers on the first page guarantee, SEO, web design and conversion rate optimization. Every video plays right on this page.
- [Free SEO Audit](https://seoguarantee.com/seo-audit/): Get a free SEO audit of your website. Enter your website and your email address, and we will send you the report.

## Services

- [Guaranteed SEO Packages: The Full Suite, Under One House](https://seoguarantee.com/services/suite/): All six services under one house: SEO, local SEO, AI search, website design and development, content writing and CRO, with the first page guarantee after an assessment.
- [Small Business SEO Services With a First Page Guarantee](https://seoguarantee.com/services/seo/): Keyword strategy, on-page and technical SEO, content and link building, measured against the businesses already on page one of Google's organic results.
- [Local SEO Agency With a Guarantee in Google's Map Results](https://seoguarantee.com/services/local-seo/): Business Profile categories, services, local pages and citations for Google's map results, measured against the businesses already showing there.
- [AI SEO Services With a Guarantee in Google's AI Answers](https://seoguarantee.com/services/ai-search-optimization/): Pages, profiles, listings and mentions that Google's AI answers can name or link, measured phrase by phrase against the sources those answers use today.
- [SEO Web Design: Websites Built to Rank and Convert](https://seoguarantee.com/services/web-design/): Websites built to rank and convert, with hosting, maintenance, updates, quick fixes and custom automation handled by the same team that runs your SEO.
- [SEO Content Writing Services: Pages Written to Rank](https://seoguarantee.com/services/content-writing/): Page text, blog posts and press releases from our writers and editors, planned from what already ranks on page one and written to be quoted and acted on.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization Services for Local Businesses](https://seoguarantee.com/services/conversion-rate-optimization/): Analytics, research, A/B testing and personalization that find where visitors leave your site and turn more of the same traffic into leads and customers.

## Blog

- [SEO Blog: Guides and Research](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/): Guides and articles on local SEO, organic SEO, AI search and the first page guarantee, by James Compton, CEO, each with its numbered sources.
- [How Does an SEO Guarantee Work? The Page-One Math](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-does-an-seo-guarantee-work/): The science behind a first page guarantee: build the phrase list, measure every page-one competitor per phrase and per place, match and exceed each signal, and promise only the share the measured gaps support.
- [Local SEO Guide: How the Map Pack Works in 2026](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/local-seo-guide/): How Google's map pack ranks businesses in 2026, in Google's current words: your Business Profile, reviews, proximity, citations, your website and AI answers, with a full checklist.
- [Organic SEO Guide: How Pages Earn a Place on Page One](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/organic-seo-guide/): How Google finds, ranks and demotes pages, in Google's own words, and the on-page, technical and link work that earns a place on page one, with the numbers that show what page one is worth.
- [AI Search Optimization: How AI Picks Businesses](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/ai-search-optimization-guide/): How Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot find and cite businesses, what Google says you need and don't, and how to measure AI visibility without fooling yourself.
- [Google Business Profile Optimization: Full Guide](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/google-business-profile-guide/): Every field of a Google Business Profile with Google's current rules on names, categories and reviews, a dated record of the features Google has changed since 2024, and a checklist that keeps you inside the rules.
- [SEO Competitor Analysis: The Audit Behind the Plan](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/seo-competitor-audit/): A seven-step SEO competitor analysis: build the phrase list, capture page one from your market, measure the map pack, the ranking pages and the AI answer, then turn every gap into a dated plan.
- [Dental Local SEO: How Practices Reach Page One](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-dental-practices-reach-page-one/): How a dental practice gets onto page one in Google's map results, organic results and AI answers: the phrase list, the Business Profile, treatment pages, reviews within Google's and the FTC's rules, links, and what the ADA Code says about advertising.
- [Dental Marketing Strategies: The Practice Guide](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/dental-marketing-guide/): The dental marketing channels that work together, in the order to build them: local search, reviews, paid search, social, email and referrals, with the budget signals the data supports, tracking that keeps patient data out of ad platforms, and the ADA's fee-splitting line.
- [Med Spa Marketing Ideas That Build Page-One Visibility](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-medical-spa-practices-reach-page-one/): How med spas reach page one: a phrase list built from treatments and places, one strong page per treatment, a complete Business Profile, genuine reviews, and the supervision, photo and ad rules that shape med spa marketing.
- [Chiropractic Marketing Ideas for Page-One Visibility](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-chiropractic-practices-reach-page-one/): How chiropractic clinics reach page one: a phrase list built from conditions, services and places, condition pages patients search for, a complete Business Profile, careful review habits, local links and AI answers.
- [Plastic Surgery Marketing Strategies for Page One](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-plastic-surgery-practices-reach-page-one/): How plastic surgery practices reach page one: procedure pages built on the ASPS 2025 figures, accurate surgeon credentials, before-and-after galleries that meet the ASPS Code and ad rules, a complete profile, reviews and AI answers.
- [How to Get Clients as a Therapist: Reach Page One](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-mental-health-practices-reach-page-one/): How therapists and counselors get clients from Google: a Business Profile where eligible, specialty pages, directory listings, the ethics codes on testimonials, privacy-safe tracking and ads, and what AI answers show.
- [Can SEO Be Guaranteed? What Can Honestly Be Promised](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/can-seo-be-guaranteed/): Rankings can't be guaranteed, and Google says so. A first page share of an agreed phrase list, checked on set dates under written terms, can be. Here is the difference, and how to read the terms.
- [Google Guaranteed vs an SEO Guarantee: What Changed](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/seo-guarantee-vs-google-guaranteed/): Google retired its Google Guaranteed badge for one Google Verified badge in October 2025. What that ads badge is, how Local Services Ads rank, and how it differs from a first page guarantee with written terms.
- [SEO Guarantee Red Flags: How to Spot SEO Scams](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/seo-guarantee-red-flags/): Seven red flags drawn from Google's, the FTC's and Ahrefs' warnings: promised positions, fake Google ties, fake reviews and first page promises with no written terms.
- [Content Gap Analysis: How to Find Every Gap to Page One](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/seo-gap-analysis/): A content gap analysis measures what the businesses on page one have that you don't: phrases, topics, links, Business Profile strength and AI answer presence. How to run one place by place, and turn it into a work order.
- [AEO vs GEO vs AIO: What Each Term Means for SEO](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/what-is-geo-aeo-aio/): GEO, AEO and AIO decoded: where each term came from, what the research behind GEO found, and what Google says you do and don't need to show up in AI answers.
- [How to Rank in AI Overviews: How Google Picks Sources](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-ai-overviews-choose-sources/): How Google decides which pages an AI Overview links to, what Google says you need to be eligible, what third-party citation studies found, and how local businesses show up.
- [ChatGPT SEO: How to Get Recommended by ChatGPT](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-to-get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): What OpenAI actually says about how ChatGPT search finds and ranks businesses, the OAI-SearchBot setting that decides eligibility, what studies found about the sources it uses, and the steps a local business controls.
- [Local SEO vs Organic SEO: Differences and Overlap](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/local-seo-vs-organic-seo/): The map pack ranks Business Profiles and the organic results rank web pages. How each one is ranked, where the signals overlap, and which to invest in first.
- [How Long Does SEO Take to Work? A Realistic Timeline](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-long-does-seo-take/): What Google and the ranking studies say about SEO timing, what can move in the first weeks, what takes months, and how 90, 180 and 365-day first page milestones line up.
- [Organic Click-Through Rate: What Page One Is Worth](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/page-one-click-through-rates/): Most organic clicks go to the first three results, page two gets almost none, and AI Overviews cut clicks further. What each major CTR study measured, and what it means for a first page goal.
- [Keyword Difficulty Explained: How the Score Is Made](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/keyword-difficulty/): Keyword difficulty is a tool's 0 to 100 estimate built mostly from the links of the pages already ranking. How Ahrefs and Semrush calculate it, what it misses, and how to use it to order the work.
- [Do Google Reviews Help SEO? Reviews and Local Rankings](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/google-reviews-and-local-rankings/): Reviews move the map results far more than organic rankings. What Google and the 2026 surveys say about count, rating, recency and replies, and the Google and FTC rules on collecting them.
- [Google Business Profile Categories: How to Choose](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/google-business-profile-categories/): The primary category is the strongest map signal local experts can name. How to choose it, when to add more, where the category list lives, and the mistakes that cost rankings or trigger suspensions.
- [Do Local Citations Still Matter for Local SEO?](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/do-citations-still-matter/): Citations are now a small map-pack factor and a bigger AI factor. What Whitespark's 2026 survey, Yext and BrightLocal found, which listings matter, and how to clean up inconsistent ones.
- [Local SEO Keyword Research: Every Phrase Customers Type](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/keyword-research-for-local-businesses/): Build the phrase list as services times modifiers times places, read Google's search data without being fooled by it, check intent on the live results page, and turn the list into a page plan.
- [Near Me SEO: How to Show Up in Near Me Searches](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/near-me-searches/): Near me searches run on the searcher's location, not on having the words near me on your page. What Google does with them, what actually helps you appear, and how to measure it properly.
- [How to Rank Higher on Google Maps: What Moves the Pack](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-to-rank-higher-on-google-maps/): What Google says decides Google Maps rankings, what the 2026 expert survey scores highest, and the fixes that move a Business Profile: categories, name and address rules, hours, reviews and proximity.
- [How to Get Google Reviews Without Breaking the Rules](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Ask every customer, make it one tap, reply to every review, and stay inside Google's policy and the FTC's rule: no incentives, no gating, no scripts. Templates for text, email and in person.
- [How to Check Google Rankings Accurately, by Location](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-to-check-google-rankings/): Why two people see different Google results, what Search Console's average position really means, how to check map results across your area and AI answers phrase by phrase, and how first page milestones are checked.
- [Dental Website Design: The Must-Haves Patients Look For](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/dental-website-must-haves/): The must-have list for a dental website: procedure pages, booking, speed, accessibility, the HIPAA privacy notice and good faith estimate information, with what each rule says and when it applies.
- [HIPAA Marketing Rules for Dentists: Reviews, Photos, Pixels](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/hipaa-and-dental-marketing/): What HIPAA's marketing rule says, who it binds and where dental practices get caught: review replies, patient photos, testimonials and tracking tools, including exactly what the 2024 court ruling changed.
- [How to Get More Dental Patients: What Patients Look For](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/how-patients-choose-a-dentist/): How patients find and choose a dentist, from named 2024-2026 surveys and ADA Health Policy Institute data, and the order of work that gets a practice more new patients.
- [SEO vs PPC for Dentists: Cost, Speed and What You Keep](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/dental-seo-vs-dental-ppc/): How dental SEO and PPC compare on cost, timing and what lasts, with LocaliQ's dental ad benchmarks, Google's health ad rules, Local Services Ads and a plan for using both.
- [Google Business Profile for Dentists: Setup and Tips](https://seoguarantee.com/blog/google-business-profile-for-dentists/): How to set up a Google Business Profile for a dental practice under Google's own rules: practitioner profiles, the right categories and services, photos and hours, reviews and replies that protect patient privacy, and tracking.
